product.name: KarigarAI
product.description: A web application intended to connect Indian artisans with digital commerce and AI-assisted storytelling.

features.question: What is KarigarAI?
features.answer: KarigarAI is a web application designed to connect Indian artisans with digital commerce and AI-assisted storytelling. It currently includes an artisan marketplace, artisan registration and profiles, product listing, an AI chat assistant, and an AI Story Generator.
features.hindi_answer: KarigarAI एक वेब एप्लिकेशन है जो भारतीय कारीगरों को डिजिटल कॉमर्स और AI की मदद से अपनी कला और उत्पादों को प्रस्तुत करने में मदद करता है।

features.question: What can I do from the KarigarAI homepage?
features.answer: The homepage provides information about KarigarAI, its artisan-focused mission, navigation to the marketplace and Story Generator, and authentication prompts.
features.hindi_answer: KarigarAI के homepage से आप platform की जानकारी देख सकते हैं, marketplace और Story Generator पर जा सकते हैं।

features.question: How do I sign in?
features.answer: KarigarAI uses Clerk for authentication and provides a Sign In interface. Just click on 'Sign In' at the top of the page.
features.hindi_answer: KarigarAI authentication के लिए Clerk का उपयोग करता है। आप पेज के ऊपर 'Sign In' पर क्लिक कर सकते हैं।

features.question: How do I sign up?
features.answer: KarigarAI uses Clerk for account creation and a Sign Up interface exists. Please click 'Sign Up' to create a buyer or artisan account.
features.hindi_answer: KarigarAI account creation के लिए Clerk का उपयोग करता है। नया अकाउंट बनाने के लिए 'Sign Up' पर क्लिक करें।

features.question: Can I view or edit my profile?
features.answer: Yes. The Dashboard has a profile section that loads your information. You can edit your username, phone, address, bio, and upload a profile image.
features.hindi_answer: हाँ। Dashboard में profile section है जहाँ आपकी profile information दिखाई जाती है, और आप इसे अपडेट भी कर सकते हैं।

features.question: What can I see in the Dashboard?
features.answer: The Dashboard contains your profile information, artisan/product sections, product counts and views, and sales tips. Note: Some statistics and tables are currently sample data.
features.hindi_answer: Dashboard में profile information, artisan/product sections, product count और views, sales tips दिखाई देते हैं।

features.question: How can I register as an artisan?
features.answer: KarigarAI provides an artisan registration form in the Dashboard that collects personal, craft, shop/business, media, and payment-related information.
features.hindi_answer: KarigarAI में artisan registration form उपलब्ध है जिसमें craft, shop/business, media और payment-related information ली जाती है।

features.question: How do I add a product?
features.answer: The Dashboard has a product creation form for title, category, price, stock, description, and images (up to 6 files, max 8MB each).
features.hindi_answer: Dashboard में product creation form से title, category, price, stock, description और images भरकर product बनाया जा सकता है।

features.question: What is the Artisan Marketplace and how do I search it?
features.answer: The Artisan Marketplace is the product-browsing area of KarigarAI. You can view product cards, and perform client-side filtering using categories.
features.hindi_answer: Artisan Marketplace KarigarAI का product-browsing section है। इसमें आप products देख सकते हैं और category के आधार पर फ़िल्टर कर सकते हैं।

features.question: How can I view product details?
features.answer: Selecting a product in the marketplace opens its details view, displaying product information, views, and supporting navigation through product images.
features.hindi_answer: Marketplace में product select करने पर उसकी details दिखाई जाती हैं। इसमें product information और images देखने की सुविधा है।

features.question: Can I buy a product, track an order, or make payments?
features.answer: The marketplace displays 'Add to Cart' buttons, but the complete shopping cart, checkout, payment gateways, and order tracking workflows are currently in development and coming soon.
features.hindi_answer: Marketplace में 'Add to Cart' UI है, लेकिन shopping cart, payments और order tracking जैसी सुविधाएँ अभी बन रही हैं (coming soon)।

features.question: What is the AI Story Generator?
features.answer: The Story Generator creates marketing stories for products using artisan-entered details. It supports both English and Hindi output.
features.hindi_answer: स्टोरी जेनरेटर आपके उत्पादों के लिए आकर्षक विपणन कहानियां बनाता है। यह अंग्रेजी और हिंदी दोनों में काम करता है।
